## About
Excalibur Muffler and Automotive is a local shop in Denton. Mufflers are in the name, but we work on a lot more than that, from catalytic converters and suspension to heating and AC on your car, truck or SUV.
We build exhaust systems right here in the shop to fit each vehicle, foreign or domestic. A reviewer had Darren build a custom exhaust for a classic Chevy pickup, and another brought in a Corvette after a different shop's exhaust work went wrong.
We're rated 4.9 from 236 Google reviews. Give us a call, tell us what's going on, and we'll give you a free estimate.

## Services
- Muffler services: Fumes from a bad muffler smell unpleasant and can be a health risk. We'll get it taken care of.
- Custom and performance exhaust: Exhaust systems built in the shop to fit your car, truck or SUV.
- Catalytic converters: A reviewer came in with a check engine light, and Darren confirmed the problem was the catalytic converters.
- Suspension and under chassis: Suspension and under chassis work for your vehicle.
- Auto heating and AC: Heating and AC maintenance to keep the cab comfortable.
- Auto repair and maintenance: General repair and maintenance for your car, truck or SUV, not just mufflers.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Call us and we'll give you a free estimate.

Q: Do you take credit cards?
A: Yes, we accept all major credit cards.

Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. Foreign or domestic, we can find or build an exhaust system that fits your vehicle.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, we're open for part of the day on Saturday.

## What customers say
- "I had a great experience with Excalibur Muffler. Almost three years ago, my car’s underbody was severely rusted, which caused the exhaust to break and start dragging on the ground, making a terrible screeching noise while driving.

A couple of mechanics recommended this shop, so I took my car there. The owner was an older gentleman and was very kind and helpful. He inspected the issue, came up with a practical temporary fix, welded a metal piece to reinforce the rusted area, and got everything working again for far very reasonable cost.

That repair lasted for the next couple of years until I eventually sold the car. I really appreciate his honesty, experience, and the quality of work he provided. It’s rare to find someone who genuinely helps customers instead of just pushing expensive repairs. Highly recommend Excalibur Muffler!" (Sai K, 5/5)
- "My check engine light came on and the codes indicated it was a catalytic converter issue.  Excalibur was able to get me in the next day, the owner, Darren, verified it was the catalytic converters. He replaced both of them at a fraction of the cost of the Ford dealer or any other muffler shop.  Excalibur will be my go to shop for any exhaust work." (Terrance Steinhebel, 5/5)
- "Had some exhaust work done a few weeks ago. Although busy, they got me scheduled within 3 days. Once I dropped off my truck, the work was done quickly with excellent quality at a very reasonable cost. I highly recommend and will be going back for any future needs. They run a honest and great business!" (Thomas Moore, 5/5)
- "Darren corrected the exhaust errors that another shop created on my 2004 Corvette.  He did an incredible job troubleshooting the issues and now my car sounds and runs great.  I highly recommend Excalibur to anyone looking for a business that operates with integrity and professionalism!!!" (Chad Hawley, 5/5)
- "First class work! I asked Darren to build a custom exhaust for my '65 Chevy C10 pickup. Pretty tight fit. He totally nailed it. The exhaust is as solid as the frame. Beautiful work. Fantastic price. I'd highly recommend Excalibur Muffler." (Gary Hardy, 5/5)
